notes.title: Major Ending Update + Sale!
notes.notes:

I personally read every single review and I do agree that the game did end a bit too abruptly.

notes.title: Future of the game + Soundtrack Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I'm very happy to see the reception for this game has been very positive, as a matter of fact, it's been so positive that almost everyone seems want a sequel to the game! And my answer to that is this:

I would LOVE to make a sequel to the game, however, as I'm sure you can guess, due to the assets in the game, such as the art and music being extremely high quality, a sequel would not be cheap to make. The game would need enough sales/popularity to justify spending the funds + time on a sequel. So you can further help the future of the game by buying the soundtrack, writing reviews, recommending it to friends, etc. 

As a bonus, here is a piece of unused art that will be used in the sequel if there will be one! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40037202/35a081677e14bc54f6e6137a41856c0dec90367e.png

If for whatever reason we don't meet the demands for a more expansive sequel.  I am still open to making a continuation of the story, however it would have to obviously be cut down and re-use assets from the game (basically it would just be a sort of "extended" version of the base game sold as DLC).

So yeah! I would be most greatful if you all would continue to show your support for the game, such as by buying the newly released soundtrack or gifting it to a friend, etc. 

Purchase the soundtrack here (you don't need to own TT to own the OST):

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625660/Twilight_Town_A_Cyberpunk_Day_In_Life_Soundtrack/
